elements.label: Figure 9.8
elements.title: Choropleth Graph Showing Cases of COVID-19

details.legend/series: Color shading from light peach to dark red indicating increasing number of COVID-19 cases
details.trend: Darker color shading correlates with higher numbers of COVID-19 cases; notable darker regions include the United States, China, and parts of Europe.

elements: This choropleth map visually represents the distribution of COVID-19 cases worldwide, with darker colors indicating higher case counts. It demonstrates how geographic mapping can reveal patterns and clusters of disease spread.
